The evolution of an ecommerce brand

The old way.
The new way.

Every Amazon brand starts the same way. The ones that keep growing make one move most never make: they stop waiting for traffic and go get it.

The old way
01
Amazon only

Hands out. Waiting for the auction.

Sponsored ads, and nothing else. You take whatever keyword traffic the auction hands you, at whatever price it sets that day. Growth depends on how many people happen to search.

Search onlyOne channelSomeone else's price
The old way
02
Same shoppers, higher CPC

Paying more for new the same people.

Every competitor bids on the same keywords for the same searchers. The pie stays the same size. The slice just gets more expensive.

Flat reachRising CPCs
The old way
03
Creative on hold

No video. No TV. No budget line for it.

Commercial production means shoots, crews and quotes, so it never happens. The brands with the biggest budgets get the biggest screens.

Static imagesNo streaming TV
The new way
04
Growth in your hands

Stop waiting. Go get the shopper.

Amazon's audience network lets you reach shoppers before, after and beyond search: the ones who looked and left, the ones in your category who never typed your keyword, and the ones on the couch watching streaming TV.

Looked & leftNever searchedStreaming TV
The new way
05
Underpriced

An unfair advantage in an underpriced market.

While everyone crowds the same search auction, Amazon's audience network is still wide open. Across our portfolio the blended CPC was $1.35 with a 6.03x ROAS (Jul 16–Aug 15 2026). That gap won't stay open forever.

Streaming TV · the premium play

Big-brand TV.
Aimed like search.

Streaming TV used to be for brands with TV budgets. Through Amazon's audience network it's completely accessible: your commercial on Prime Video and premium streaming apps, positioned next to the shows people love, with the creative made for you, free.

And it isn't a shotgun. Generic CTV sprays impressions at anyone with a TV. We show your spot to the households Amazon's shopper signals say are likely to buy, then measure it in what they buy.

Generic CTV

The shotgun.

  • Bought on broad demographics and guesses
  • Impressions sprayed at anyone with a screen
  • Hard to connect to a single sale
  • Production budget before anything airs

Straight answers.

What is reMKTR? +

reMKTR (say it "re-market-er") is an ad-tech company for Amazon brands. We combine Amazon's audience network, our Target Lock AI and commercial-grade video production, and run it all for you, so you can scale beyond traditional Amazon PPC. We're a Full Circle company.

Is the first 30 days really free? +

Yes. Your first 30 days with reMKTR are free. We'll walk you through exactly how it works on the call, before you commit to anything.

What's the guarantee? +

We agree the targets with you up front. If we don't hit the targets, we'll work for free until we do.

How fast can we go live? +

In as little as one week. We build the audiences, the campaigns and the creative, then launch.

Is the creative really free? +

Yes. We build your ads and include commercial-grade creative for free: product commercials, streaming-TV spots and UGC-style video, made from your product and your Amazon listing. No Retainers. No Creative Fees.

How is this different from my sponsored ads? +

Sponsored ads catch shoppers at the moment they search. That's valuable, and it's also where everyone is bidding. reMKTR goes after everyone else: people who viewed and left, people in your category who never typed your keyword, and people watching streaming TV.

What is Target Lock? +

Our AI targeting and bidding, built on the most cutting-edge AI models available. It reads Amazon's shopper signals, builds the audiences and sets the bids. Our operators set the targets, read what comes back and own the decisions.

How do you charge after the free month? +

A percentage of ad spend. No Retainers. No Creative Fees. We'll give you the exact percentage on the call.

I'd rather run it myself. +

Then you want the product, not the service. That's Dr. DSP, our sibling. See the doors below.
